blocks.prompt: 4. How many terms of the series: \(96 + 93 + 90 + \dots\) amount to 1071.
blocks.explanation:
Series 96, 93, 90, ... har dafa 3 kam ho rahi hai, yani A.P. hai. "Amount to 1071" ka matlab hai "jin ka jama 1071 ho".
Diya kya hai? Series aur us ka jama \(S_n = 1071\).
Find kya karna hai? Kitni terms, yani \(n\).
Plan: \(S_n\) ke formula mein rakh kar \(n\) ki quadratic equation (jis mein \(n^2\) aata hai) banegi; usay solve kar ke dono jawab parakhne hain.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(96 + 93 + 90 + \dots\), \(S_n = 1071\).
Humein find karna hai: \(n\).
Tareeqa: \(a_1 = 96\) aur \(d = 93 - 96 = -3\). Inhein \(S_n = \frac{n}{2}[2a_1 + (n-1)d]\) mein rakhenge. Is formula mein \(n\) do jagah aata hai (bahar \(\frac{n}{2}\) aur andar \((n - 1)\)), is liye multiply hone par \(n^2\) banega aur quadratic equation milegi.

Equation banayein
\[1071 = \dfrac{n}{2}[2(96) + (n - 1)(-3)]\]
\[1071 = \dfrac{n}{2}(192 - 3n + 3)\]
\[1071 = \dfrac{n}{2}(195 - 3n)\]
Kyun: \(2 \times 96 = 192\), aur \((n - 1)(-3) = -3n + 3\); minus ko bracket ki dono cheezon se multiply karna hai. Phir \(192 + 3 = 195\).
Dhyan dein: \((n - 1)(-3)\) ko \(-3n - 3\) likhna aam ghalti hai; \((-1)(-3) = +3\) hota hai.

Standard quadratic shakal mein layein
\[2142 = 195n - 3n^2\]
\[3n^2 - 195n + 2142 = 0\]
\[n^2 - 65n + 714 = 0\]
Kyun: Pehle dono taraf 2 se multiply kiya taake fraction khatam ho (\(1071 \times 2 = 2142\)). Phir sab terms ek taraf le aaye taake \(an^2 + bn + c = 0\) wali shakal bane. Aakhir mein har term 3 par divide hoti thi, to 3 se divide kar ke numbers chhote kar liye.

Factorize karein
\[n^2 - 14n - 51n + 714 = 0\]
\[n(n - 14) - 51(n - 14) = 0\]
\[(n - 14)(n - 51) = 0\]
\[n = 14 \text{ or } n = 51\]
Kyun: Aise do numbers chahiye jin ka product 714 aur jama 65 ho: 14 aur 51 (\(14 \times 51 = 714\), \(14 + 51 = 65\)). Middle term ko \(-14n - 51n\) mein tora aur common nikala. Do brackets ka product zero ho to koi ek zaroor zero hota hai.

Dono jawab kyun sahi hain?
\[a_{14} = 96 + 13(-3) = 57\]
\[a_{15} = 54,\quad a_{51} = 96 + 50(-3) = -54\]
Kyun: Yeh sawal ka sab se dilchasp hissa hai. Series ghat rahi hai, is liye aage ja kar terms zero aur phir negative ho jati hain. Term 15 se term 51 tak: \(54, 51, \dots, 3, 0, -3, \dots, -54\). Har positive term ka ek barabar negative saathi hai (54 aur \(-54\), 51 aur \(-51\)...), to in 37 terms ka jama 0 hai. Zero jorne se jama nahi badalta, is liye 14 terms ka jama bhi 1071 aur 51 terms ka bhi 1071.
Dhyan dein: Ek jawab ko "ghalat" samajh kar mat chhoriye; dono \(n\) positive whole numbers hain aur dono sahi hain.

Tasdeeq: dono ko check karein
\[S_{14} = \dfrac{14}{2}(96 + 57)\]
\[= 7 \times 153 = 1071 \;\checkmark\]
\[S_{51} = \dfrac{51}{2}(96 - 54)\]
\[= \dfrac{51}{2}(42) = 1071 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Pehli aur aakhri term ke formula se dono values ka jama 1071 aaya. Answer key bhi "14, 51" deti hai.
blocks.final_answer:
\(n = 14\) ya \(n = 51\) terms
Dono sahi hain, kyunke term 15 se 51 tak ka jama zero hai.
